label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to name variable, which is used in both InetAddress.getByName() DNS resolution AND the URL fetch at https://+name+/health. The .endsWith('.internal') check only blocks names ending in '.internal', allowing arbitrary domain enumeration attacks. Resolved sink value is attacker-controlled user input reaching the outbound stream fetch.

evidence.note: User param flows to name, used in DNS resolution then URL fetch without proper sanitization
